articles.title: Strabag secures construction contract for Pfaffensteig tunnel in Germany
articles.summary: The Pfaffensteig Tunnel, spanning 11km, will be built as a twin-bore tunnel, each containing a single railway track.

articles.title: Strabag consortium leads $207m D35 motorway project in Czech Republic
articles.summary: Construction commenced in April 2026, with the road expected to open to traffic after 34 months.

articles.title: Strabag closes acquisition of Crofton Engineering
articles.summary: Crofton Engineering will remain at its site in Linton, Cambridgeshire, UK, and retain its name and senior management team.

articles.title: Strabag consortium wins $224m expressway contract in Slovenia
articles.summary: Construction on the project is scheduled to begin this month, with the work expected to last approximately 40 months.
